requested_outcome: Identify whether the failed Sites publication is caused by an account or server limit, remove the causal build risk without changing public behavior, and produce a verified release candidate without publishing it.
natural_destination: The local VII release candidate build artifact and the managed Sites deployment pipeline.
authorization_boundary: Read account and project state, change and test the local candidate. Do not publish to production without a new explicit publication instruction.

lesson_bundle.reason: VII project guidance controls the release pipeline and accepted product invariants.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The fix must preserve the complete VII candidate and its accepted release gates.

lesson_bundle.reason: A successful build alone is not enough to claim the publication issue is solved.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify output integrity, size, referenced assets and the affected release family before handoff.

lesson_bundle.reason: The failed operation is a production deployment and must preserve rollback and exact source identity.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep v789 as rollback, freeze the new source and do not publish without explicit authorization.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The diagnosis blames the account without evidence.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Compare account usage, project state, successful baseline and failed deployment telemetry.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Evidence distinguishes account limits from build artifact risk.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The cleanup removes a live image or changes a supplier gallery.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Prune only verified-media output paths with no explicit runtime reference and fail when any referenced path is missing.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every explicit verified-media reference resolves after the build.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The build remains close enough to the platform ceiling to fail again.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a fail-closed artifact size budget well below the known 256 MiB ceiling.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The final dist size is below the configured budget.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local repair is reported as public even though it was not deployed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep publication outside the authorization boundary and report the exact local state.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No new managed Version or Deployment is created during this task.

sources.label: VII release protocol and product invariants

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first clean build with reachability pruning and before the broader release gates.
checks: Measure final dist size and file count.
Verify every explicit verified-media reference exists in dist.
Confirm only unreferenced output copies were removed.

attack_questions: Can a dynamic verified-media path bypass the reference inventory?
Can an explicit verified-media reference be absent from dist after pruning?
Can the artifact exceed the safety budget without failing the build?
Did any unrelated source or public deployment change?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A clean local production build with exact size, asset-integrity and source-gate output.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Tests cover reachability, missing references, budget failure, existing aliases and the release gates.

effectiveness.baseline: The v790 dist contains 1933 files and 253.67 MiB after existing duplicate pruning, while both managed deployments failed during building.
effectiveness.target: Reduce the artifact by at least 80 MiB, remain below 220 MiB and preserve every referenced verified-media asset.
